trial.q: How do I get a free trial?
trial.a: Create your account and request a trial from the app, or email KahalZerem@gmail.com. If approved, we grant access for the agreed number of days.

paypal.a: You can pay with PayPal at signup or later from billing. If you pay without requesting a trial, charging and access start immediately.

email.q: Do I need to verify my email?
email.a: Yes. For security we send a verification link when you register. Without verification, panel access stays limited.

plans.a: Yes. From billing you can upgrade or downgrade as your church needs change.

cancel.a: Yes, with no penalty. Access continues until the end of the paid period.

reino.q: What does the Kingdom Plan include?
reino.a: Every module (including Kids, Camps, Marketplace and the Apostle multi-site network), up to 10,000 members, unlimited users and ushers, up to 50 layouts of 10,000 seats, a 20% campus discount and priority support.

apostol.a: The multi-site network included in the Kingdom Plan: manage child churches with a network panel and church switcher. Each child church has its own plan, with a 20% campus discount.

camps.q: What does the Camps module include?
camps.a: Retreat logistics: map/layout, campers, registrations and payments, roll call, buses, live itinerary, alerts, health and staff chat. Included in Kingdom.

kids.a: Secure kids check-in and pick-up: registration with allergies and consents, family QR code, PIN and photo at pick-up, room map, MISSING alert and reports. Included in Kingdom.

limits.q: What happens if I reach my plan limit?
limits.a: Nothing is deleted. You just can't add more members, users, layouts or ushers until you upgrade. Seed: 500 members and 10 users; Growth: 2,000 members and 20 users; Kingdom: 10,000 members.
